identity.name: unsloth
identity.type: Library + Application (dual: finetuning library + desktop Studio)

business_signals.one_liner: Unsloth makes LLM finetuning 2x faster with 70% less VRAM and ships a local Studio to run/train 500+ models (text/audio/embedding/vision).
target_users: ML practitioners fine-tuning LLMs on consumer/single GPUs
Local-model enthusiasts running GGUF/safetensors/LoRA via OpenAI/Anthropic-compatible APIs
Teams needing local RL (GRPO/DPO) and long-context training
use_cases: Studio: visual data recipes, model arena, tool-calling, MCP control endpoint
non_goals: Not a model host/SaaS (local-first; cloud only via user-run endpoints)
FastSentenceTransformer & several TRL trainers unsupported on MLX backend
differentiators: Hand-written Triton/CUDA/MLX kernels replace HF native ops (RMSNorm, RoPE, SwiGLU, cross-entropy, LoRA, FP8)
2x speed / 70% less VRAM / MoE up to 12x
Import-time monkey-patching of transformers/peft/trl so existing notebooks run unchanged
Dual MLX (Apple Silicon) + CUDA/ROCm/XPU backend from one import
